data.question: How can a tumor hide from cytotoxic CD8+ T cells?

branches.label: Keep MHC class I
branches.detail: presents cancer peptides — visible to CD8+ T cells

branches.label: Delete MHC class I
branches.detail: no peptide display — invisible to CD8+ T cells

resolver.label: Cross-monitoring
resolver.detail: T cells watch MHC-present cells; NK cells (KIR / NKG2A) watch MHC-absent cells

S10.meta: // SLIDE 10 — WORKED EXAMPLE — HIGH TMB, NO RESPONSE

data.question: High mutational burden, abundant neoantigens — but no response. Why?

branches.label: Too few targets
branches.detail: not enough neoantigens to prime T cells

branches.label: T cells excluded
branches.detail: primed T cells blocked at the margin by dense matrix and aberrant vessels

resolver.label: Walk the cycle
resolver.detail: T cells present at the margin, absent from the core — the limiting step, not the average, decides
